description: Potential PassRole Path to an Administrator-Like Service Role
rationale: Identity policies on one IAM role appear to allow both iam:PassRole for a different administrator-like IAM role and ec2:RunInstances or lambda:CreateFunction with the target role's service trust. This is an unverified privilege-delegation candidate, not proven effective permission or a demonstrated exploit. SCPs, permissions boundaries, resource policies, session context and operational access are not simulated.
remediation: Review source-to-target IAM policy permissions, trust, permissions boundaries, applicable organization policies, role hierarchy and access to resulting workloads. Limit iam:PassRole ARNs and iam:PassedToService; grant only necessary service creation privileges.
